chunks: And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Ahmad ibn Muhsin, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, from Ubayd ibn Zur'arah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about a man who divorced his wife while he was ill, and a year passed in that condition. He said: 'She inherits him if the illness in which he divorced her is the one from which he did not recover.'
ai.seo_question: Does a divorce issued during an illness affect the wife's right to inherit if the husband dies from that same illness?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the condition of 'death illness' (marad al-mawt) by specifying that the divorce does not sever inheritance rights only if the husband dies from the exact same illness in which the divorce occurred. This precise linkage distinguishes it from general divorce rulings, emphasizing that the marital bond remains intact for inheritance purposes as long as the specific pathological state persists until death.
